hero.title: WHERE SOUND, SKILL, AND CREATIVE CONFIDENCE ARE BUILT.
hero.subtitle: Record vocals, produce music, build podcasts, and learn instruments inside a studio environment designed for creators.

zones.title: Five studio lanes arranged like one working production room.
zones.body: Each zone is built to feel practical and media-first, with clear labels, real session energy, and room for creators to learn by doing.

recordingStudio.label: Tracking Room
recordingStudio.title: Recording Studio
recordingStudio.description: A focused room for vocals, demo takes, guided recording, and repeat sessions that help creators settle into the mic.

musicProduction.label: Production Desk
musicProduction.title: Music Production
musicProduction.description: Build beats, shape arrangements, and move rough ideas into stronger drafts with studio guidance and a clean workflow.

podcastSetup.label: Voice Booth
podcastSetup.title: Podcast Setup
podcastSetup.description: Create spoken-word sessions, interviews, and voice-led content in a setup that keeps the conversation clear and controlled.

instrumentTraining.label: Practice Corner
instrumentTraining.title: Instrument Training
instrumentTraining.description: Hands-on piano, guitar, drums, and vocal practice designed to build rhythm, confidence, and repetition inside the studio.

creativePracticeSessions.label: Creator Lab
creativePracticeSessions.title: Creative Practice Sessions
creativePracticeSessions.description: A broad space for creators to test ideas, rehearse, repeat, and grow comfortable with the tools and pace of real sessions.

path.title: A session log that moves from first sound to finished output.
path.body: This path is meant to feel like a production board, not a classroom outline. It keeps the creator moving through tools, practice, and recorded work with momentum.

steps.title: Pick Your Sound
steps.description: Choose the instrument, voice, or format you want to shape and define the creative direction early.

steps.title: Learn the Tools
steps.description: Get comfortable with the studio tools, session flow, and practical habits that make creation easier.

steps.title: Practice in Session
steps.description: Repeat key parts, build control, and learn through active sessions instead of passive theory.

steps.title: Record / Produce
steps.description: Move into takes, drafts, beats, edits, or voice capture once the creative direction feels ready.

steps.title: Package Your Output
steps.description: Shape the result into something shareable, reviewable, or ready for the next creative step.

atmosphere.title: Microphones, instruments, desks, and creator energy held in one room.
atmosphere.body: The atmosphere stays broad and honest: hands-on practice, recording focus, and a studio setup that helps creators grow more comfortable with real production spaces.

cta.title: STEP INTO THE STUDIO AND BUILD YOUR SOUND.
cta.subtitle: Start with a focused session, ask about training, or open a direct WhatsApp conversation and we will guide the next step.
